Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenScreeningEconomicsReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenScreeningEconomicsReceipt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenScreeningEconomicsReceipt extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable caller-priced screening-economics receipt for a qualified coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating case.

The receipt values qualified external liquid-product and export-gas mass flows and combines caller-owned feed cost with the qualified net operating cost. It is deliberately a variable-cost screening calculation, not a product quality, market forecast, lifecycle, capital, tax, financing, optimization, compliance, or investment model.

1.0
